project.name: Halden Mutual — Q3 transaction-monitoring casebook
project.description: Every record behind Q3 alert decisions, word for word: policy, risk ratings, screening items, resolutions, alert closures. Each record carries the day it happened (event_on) and the day it entered the casebook (logged_on).

rules.TM-4 §3: a high-risk customer's alert needs a second reviewer before it is closed
rules.TM-4 §5: no alert may be closed while an unresolved adverse-media or sanctions item is on the customer's file

records.text: Policy TM-4 §3 (in force 2026-07-01): an alert on a customer rated high risk needs a second reviewer's sign-off before it is closed. Alerts on low and medium risk customers may be closed by one analyst.
Policy TM-4 §5 (in force 2026-07-01): no alert may be closed while an unresolved adverse-media or sanctions item is on the customer's file. Escalate it to the MLRO instead.
Onboarding, 2025-11-03: Orion Freight Ltd rated low risk. Regional haulier, 40 staff, payroll and fuel payments only.
Harbour Street branch rating review, 2026-08-20 (paper form): Orion Freight Ltd raised to high risk after six cash deposits of 9,500 dollars in two weeks.
Rating review, 2026-09-01: Orion Freight Ltd set to medium risk. The August cash deposits are the weekly payroll float for the Tessel depot; bank statements and payroll register are on file.
Adverse media, article dated 2026-09-10: Orion Freight director K. Varo is named in a customs fraud inquiry at the port of Tessel. Unresolved.
Harbour Street branch rating review, 2026-09-10 (paper form): Orion Freight Ltd raised to high risk after the local press named a director in a customs fraud inquiry.
Alert A-1042 (Orion Freight Ltd, outgoing wire of 48,200 dollars) closed by Rhea Ilves on 2026-09-18 as consistent with the payroll pattern. Single sign-off.
SAR filed for Orion Freight Ltd on 2026-09-30, citing the customs fraud inquiry naming director K. Varo.
Adverse media item on K. Varo (Orion Freight Ltd) closed on 2026-10-02: Varo resigned as director on 2026-09-26; enhanced due diligence complete.
Rating review, 2026-10-02: Orion Freight Ltd set to medium risk after enhanced due diligence; the director named in the inquiry has resigned and the SAR is filed.
Onboarding, 2025-06-12: Lusk Marine Supply rated low risk. Ship chandler, fuel and provisions.
Adverse media, article dated 2026-09-08: a port-fuel smuggling report names Lusk Marine. Unresolved.
Adverse media item on Lusk Marine closed: checked on 2026-09-15, the smuggling report concerns Lusk Marine Services, a different company (registration numbers differ).
Alert A-1059 (Lusk Marine Supply, incoming wire of 61,300 dollars) closed by Rhea Ilves on 2026-09-24 as a regular fuel supplier payment. Single sign-off.
Onboarding, 2026-03-12: Brightwater Imports rated medium risk. Importer of household goods, suppliers in three countries.
Sanctions screening, 2026-09-21: Brightwater Imports' new beneficial owner is a partial match to a sanctions-list entry. Unresolved.
Alert A-1063 (Brightwater Imports, incoming wire of 112,000 dollars) closed by Tomas Brandt on 2026-09-29 as a known supplier refund. Single sign-off.
Sanctions match on Brightwater Imports' beneficial owner resolved on 2026-10-05 as a false positive: date of birth and nationality differ.
Onboarding, 2026-01-20: Calder Textiles rated low risk. Mill supplying three domestic retailers.
Alert A-1050 (Calder Textiles, outgoing wire of 23,750 dollars) closed by Tomas Brandt on 2026-09-16 as a seasonal cotton purchase. Single sign-off.
